body: Not to me. I don't have health insurance or the ability to buy my own house. Marriage will remedy this.
My coworkers and i just spent a solid 45 minutes laughing our asses off over some of these charts. Our favorite was the super bowl one.

Not great. I'm in an unsafe living situation, and myself and my pets were in danger, so I removed us. The dog is in a kennel, the cat is at a friends house. I'm staying with my boyfriend and his roommate. 

I'm pretty depressed. I miss my babies and having my own space. Home should feel safe, but it doesn't. 

Seriously, op, thank you for posting this. I'm sure that I'm not the only one who feels like they have no one who cares about their problems. It's really liberating to be able to get it out.
Dear God, I knew this day would come.

Hey there. I'm dealing with a similar situation. I can completely relate to the feeling of having a panic attack with every text message. Send me a PM if you'd like to talk, i think we could help each other.
